Getting worse day day by. Myntra service quality has been consistently declining, especially in the past few months. What used to be a reliable and convenient platform has now become a frustrating experience for regular shoppers. Orders frequently get delayed without any clear communication or updated delivery timelines. In some cases, the expected delivery date is completely missing, leaving customers in the dark. Worse still, the platform has developed a troubling pattern of sending incorrect or poor-quality items. There have been instances where customers order premium products, only to receive cheaper substitutes — sometimes without original tags, raising serious concerns about authenticity and quality control. It almost feels like the original branded product is retained in their warehouse, and a lower-grade item is shipped instead. This not only undermines trust but also reflects poorly on Myntra’s handling of inventory and commitment to customer satisfaction. The return and refund process isn’t always smooth either, adding another layer of inconvenience. If you have plenty of time and patience, you might be able to navigate through these issues — but for most people, shopping on Myntra has gone from hassle-free to highly unreliable. It’s disappointing to see a once-dependable platform fall short on the basics: timely delivery, product accuracy, and transparent communication

From being an amazing brand to a shady brand. I had been a loyal customer for years, easily making purchases worth over a few lakhs, but Myntra’s customer policies have turned absolutely draconian over the last two years. I finally uninstalled the app over a year ago, and here is why: * Failed Returns & Lost Money: I was delivered the wrong item. I shared the required photos, initiated a return, and the item was successfully picked up. However, due to an issue with their logistics partner, the return was not delivered back to them. Even though the system acknowledged the return request, they completely refused to refund me. I was left with no product (right or wrong) and had to absorb a shameless loss of ₹3.8K. * Repeat Offense: I foolishly let the first incident pass, thinking it was a one-off system glitch. Then, the exact same cycle happened again. While other e-commerce companies, even their parent company, Flipkart are continually making their customer policies better, Myntra is going down the drain. Their customer service is entirely bottlenecked by rigid, anti-consumer rules; agents just put their hands up and repeat, "We can't do anything else." Highly disappointed. Save your money and shop elsewhere

A Customer Service Nightmare — Money and Returns Left Unresolved..deactivated account blocked  money. At present, I no longer consider Myntra a trustworthy shopping platform based on my experience. Customers may receive incomplete, incorrect, or entirely different products from what they ordered, and even when valid return requests are raised with supporting evidence, they can face unnecessary rejection or delays. What is even more concerning is the suspension or deactivation of a customer’s account while valid returns, refunds, and the customer’s money remain unresolved. Myntra should prioritize customer protection, transparent investigations, genuine pickup attempts, timely refunds, and fair treatment instead of leaving customers to struggle to recover money for products they did not receive correctly.
